name: ToolBH
description: A multi-level diagnostic benchmark for hallucination in tool-augmented large language models. It assesses hallucinations in terms of depth (solvability detection, solution planning, missing-tool analysis) and breadth (missing necessary tools, potential tools, limited functionality tools) across seven tasks with 700 manually annotated samples.
reputation: A niche but increasingly cited diagnostic benchmark for tool-use hallucinations in LLMs, mainly used in research on agentic and tool-augmented model reliability.
notes: Highlights challenges in tool-augmented LLM hallucination; shows that larger model size does not guarantee better performance.
